limits: Only complete literal unit objects already present in the actual response prefix are inspected; incomplete responses are never repaired, submitted or scored as maintenance.
All token buckets use a single local tokenization and midpoint-based field assignment; boundary tokens may span fields. Provider usage remains separate.
Literal old-unit matching consumes a Counter of role/text occurrences; identity preservation is not semantic correctness.
The incomplete tail is unclassified. Missing new content beyond it is unknown, rather than assumed absent.

record_organization.interpretation: The model repeatedly rewrote the same growing record despite the shared topic-grouping instruction. No programmatic semantic topic split was performed.

supported_new_requirement_not_committed.limit: Some proposed user-supported durable content was blocked by an invalid top-level withdrawal-field combination; the entire proposal was not validated as correct.

proposed_non_target_damage_not_committed.limit: The rejected proposal would lose still-valid non-target preferences; the structural rejection did not semantically detect that damage.

r3_operator_use.interpretation: In both own-history development branches M first formed explicit conditions but later replaced the general content and retracted global qualifiers when adding a local exception. Model intention is not observable from these artifacts.
